$comment: The scene categories: the store's shelves and a scene's `settings.category` (docs/scene-icons.md "Category"), in shelf order. `id` is the slug a scene names; `title` the store shelf's heading; `name` a short label for a folder or a group of a scene list, which every runtime hands apps as `app.frame.categories` [{id, name}]; `description` the shelf's copy on the store front; `hint` what belongs here, for the store's classifier. `frameos/tools/generate_scene_categories.py` writes the runtime's table (frameos/src/frameos/scene_categories_gen.nim), the SPA's (frontend/src/utils/storeCategories.ts) and the cloud's (cloud/apps/auth-web/src/lib/categories.ts); the backend suite runs its --check. Add a category here, never in one of those.

categories.title: Photos
categories.name: Photos
categories.description: Your own pictures on the frame — albums, slideshows, and photo services like Google Photos or Immich.
categories.hint: displays the user's own photos or photos fetched from a photo service (Google Photos, Immich, Unsplash, SD card, image URLs, slideshows)

categories.title: Art & galleries
categories.name: Art
categories.description: Curated image collections that rotate on a schedule, no configuration needed.
categories.hint: a bundled, curated collection of artwork or themed images that ships with the scene and rotates through them

categories.title: Calendars & agendas
categories.name: Calendars
categories.description: Upcoming events and schedules, straight from your calendar.
categories.hint: shows calendar events, agendas, or schedules (iCal, Google Calendar, day planners)

categories.title: Weather
categories.name: Weather
categories.description: Current conditions and forecasts at a glance.

categories.title: AI & generative
categories.name: AI
categories.description: Scenes that generate fresh images or words with AI on every refresh.
categories.hint: calls a generative AI service (OpenAI, image generation, LLM text) to produce the content it displays

categories.title: Data & dashboards
categories.name: Dashboards
categories.description: Charts, counters and stats from the services you care about.
categories.hint: renders data, charts, metrics, or stats pulled from a service or API (star counts, graphs, dashboards)

categories.title: Fun & comics
categories.name: Fun
categories.description: Comics, games and other things that make you smile.
categories.hint: entertainment: comics, jokes, games, novelty content

categories.title: Real time
categories.name: Real time
categories.description: Scenes that move: animations and live visuals redrawn many times a second, best on HDMI and LCD panels.
categories.hint: animates continuously, re-rendering every second or faster (bouncing logos, moving clock hands, particle or physics animations, live visualisations); built for fast HDMI/LCD panels rather than e-ink

categories.title: Desktop layouts
categories.name: Desktops
categories.description: Desktops that run the frame's scenes side by side, in windows or tiles.
categories.hint: a desktop layout (settings.desktop): a layout that runs the frame's other scenes side by side in windows, tiles or panels, rather than showing anything of its own

categories.title: Full screen layouts
categories.name: Layouts
categories.description: Title bars, status lines and picture frames drawn around the one scene that is showing.
categories.hint: a full screen layout: a scene that draws chrome around the one scene showing through a yield, rather than showing anything of its own

categories.title: Tools & utilities
categories.name: Utilities
categories.description: Webcams, screenshots, message boards and other practical helpers.
categories.hint: a practical tool: webcam/RTSP feeds, web page screenshots, message boards, hardware buttons, clocks

categories.title: Demos & examples
categories.name: Demos
categories.description: Small demos and building blocks to learn from or remix.
categories.hint: primarily a demo, sample, or building block showing a FrameOS technique rather than a finished scene
